title: Figure 46: real acoustic pressure vs radial distance, 5000 Hz radiating sphere
description: ANSYS 12.1 line graph of steady-state real component of pressure (Pa) versus radial distance (m) for 5,000 Hz with 25 elements per wavelength in water. Rapidly oscillating decaying waveform for the uniformly radiating sphere EPW=25, ANSYS versus theory. Part of the BAASS acoustic frequency comparison.
